text_block_list.text:
At the end of training one day, Special
Week
comes to Марузенски to learn how
to cook.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why hello there, Spe! I'm so happy to
see you,
but what brings you here all of
a sudden?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Actually, Tazuna recently showed me a
picture of
some food you made!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It looked soooo delicious, I couldn't get
it out of
my mind...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I want to make wonderful dishes like
that, too!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Heehee, so that's it. Well, you certainly
do
appreciate good food, Spe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Okay, leave it to me. I'll drop some
knowledge on
you!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Now, what shall we make...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Maybe a wholesome, filling soup that
can be
made in a jiffy on a busy
morning...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Or how about a slow-cooked, savory
stew?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Those both sound amazing! I can't
decide!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Why don't you decide, Тренер? I'll even let you have some when it's done! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: A filling soup that can be made in a jiffy!

text_block_list.text: Why don't you decide, Тренер? I'll even let you have some when it's done! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: A filling soup that can be made in a jiffy!

text_block_list.text:
All righty, then! Let's learn to whip this
thing up in
five minutes! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: F-five minutes?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll do my best!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...Add broth and water to the pot and
then chop
the other ingredients before it
comes to a boil!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: All of them?! The carrots, onions, mushrooms, and celery?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It takes about two and a half minutes to
boil, so
let's see those slice and dice
skills!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Oh gosh!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Soon, the colorful vegetable soup is
ready!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well done! You managed to do it within
five
minutes! Great work, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Yaaay, I did it! And it smells so good!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess I've become a little like

Марузенски now... ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thanks, Spe! I feel like teaching
you helped
me improve too! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Right on! Let's cook a savory stew slowly
over five
hours!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Five hours?! O-okay! I'll do my best!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Let it simmer ever so slowly over low
heat. And
make sure to skim off any fat
that bubbles up to
the top.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Slowly... Ever so slowly... I'm getting
pretty
hungry.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! You have to resist the
temptation to turn
up the heat. A
delicious stew can't be rushed!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Wow, it smells so good! Isn't it almost
ready?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, it is about time! ♪ Now that everything's been cooked, switch pots and add water and seasonings...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Then put the lid on and let it simmer for
another
two hours!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Two more hours?! I can't wait that long!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the flavors mix and deepen,
and the
scrumptious stew is ready!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mmm! It smells so good! I wanna eat it
right now!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I don't think I can resist any
longer,
myself. Let's chow down! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
The slow stew that Марузенски shows
Special
Week ends up being luscious
and full of flavor!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The quick soup that Марузенски shows
Special
Week ends up being very
nutritious and tasty!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
